notes.title: Hotfix - Balancing
notes.content:
Hotfix Notes

    Increased champion health and damage.
    Decreased turret price and increased turret damage.
    Made the tutorial level easier for a smoother player experience.
    Balanced units to better align with their strengths.

Thank you for your continued support! If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please share them on our subreddit r/SwordSpire or email us directly at swordspire2090@gmail.com.
